issue_context.title: Make tidb_partition_prune_mode = 'dynamic' the default
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
The dynamic partition prune mode is now GA and should be made default, so we can eventually deprecate the static mode and then remove the tidb_partition_prune_mode variable and simplify the code by removing the static dynamic prune mode code.

review_comments:
If you remove this line, you should be able to remove this corresponding code:

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/12ae85f32b11ba4ed5ed9ec111cb6777d860e3ac/session/bootstrap.go#L2062-L2065

(Which is great: having differing defaults is bound to cause user issues).
